feature: Circle AroundCurve with guide/edge picking and shared size getters

profiles.comparison: Full command/frontend geometry, selection and actual history at 1e-6 for projected centers/radii, preselection, numeric radius/diameter and picked/numeric circumference and area.

Full command/frontend geometry/history at 1e-6 for analytic/NURBS/polyline guides, endpoints and kink tangents, spatial and reversed frames, relative/CPlane input, three owned edge clicks and explicit remembered radius/diameter/three-point workflows.
Full command/frontend geometry/history at 1e-6 for fixed numeric seams on eight curved/spatial/edge guides, plus a corrected zero-radius retry; two further owned edge clicks.
Full geometry/history at 1e-6: a plain 2Point construction retains the prior radius while the 3Point Radius option updates it.
Clean native cancellations at source, center, radius, preselected center and circumference getters; command/frontend replay preserves sources and leaves no output or history.
Excluded: Orientation is unavailable in AroundCurve, and the native attempt contains Unknown command plus incomplete input receipts.

qualifications: Circle AroundCurve reuses the existing pure CircleInput size constructor, CapturedCurve immutable sources and perpendicular-frame helper; previews and completed command geometry share sizing and projection.
One preselected whole curve or explicit whole/surface/Brep-edge source can be bound. Closest centers clamp to endpoints; size points are projected into the captured tangent-normal plane.

Radius and Diameter picks set radius and seam, while typed Diameter values are halved. Circumference and Area use projected distance as their scalar size and retain the guide-frame seam for picked or typed input.

Forty-three successful native workflows compare all NURBS controls, weights, knots, domains, lengths, source geometry, returned selection and actual Undo/Redo through command and frontend on both backends at absolute 1e-6.
Five owned public viewport edge clicks have authored parent-edge/point and acknowledgement receipts: surface and curved-surface edges, a box Brep edge and two numeric-size recaptures.

Controlled native workflows measure radius and Radius/Diameter memory, Enter defaults, retention after plain 2Point/3Point construction and updates from the 3Point Radius option. Preferences belong to the command registry and survive model Undo/Redo.

A nonpositive numeric radius is rejected without leaving the getter; a later authored value completes the native/local workflow. Five clean cancellations replay with unchanged sources, no output and no history.

Local checks cover parameter picks with coordinate filters, preview/commit seam equality, point-mode Diameter sizing, selection cleanup on interruption, radius errors, and area scalars without accidental length-unit conversion.

Local source freshness checks cover geometry replacement, deletion, hiding, locking and tolerance changes before and after the center. They clear old center/size state and filters/constraints, retain the chosen size mode and require reselection without helper objects.

Ellipse and Circle probes now share bounded recipe validation and Rust fixture/history setup. Existing 115 Ellipse workflows remain regression coverage on both backends; they are not new native captures.
source_selection_policy: Local after compares native after_script, the returned command state. Native EndCommand after temporarily retains a postselected whole guide. Returned/Undo/Redo snapshots release that highlight, preserve preselection and leave edge parents unselected.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Ten successful sizing/projection/preselection workflows and one separate unsupported Orientation diagnostic.
Twenty-two complete guide, relative, edge and preference workflows after adding the observed public 3Point getter prompt prefixes. The earlier adapter setup failure promoted no rows.
Eight fixed numeric-frame guide workflows, one corrected zero-radius retry and five clean cancellation controls.
Two additional controlled preference workflows for plain 2Point retention and 3Point Radius updates.

metric_policy: All 43 successful native workflows qualify at absolute 1e-6 through command/frontend on both backends. Five cancelled workflows also compare source/geometry/history state. The incomplete unsupported Orientation attempt is excluded; all promoted inputs and observation rows retain their original values. Typed radius-point and size-mode behavior are qualified; exhaustive physical snapping and performance are not.
unqualified: Circle Deformable and Tangent construction remain unimplemented
The native per-getter ProjectOsnap switch, exhaustive physical snapping and perspective/aperture parity
Explicit area-unit suffixes: area accepts scalars/calculator expressions in squared document units and rejects length suffixes
Native preference updates on cancellation: pending local size-mode edits save only after success
Native source-freshness behavior, extreme ranges, complete legacy Circle default-option parity and performance parity
